steps.eval: (function(){ var keep = __DQ.rosterSnapshot(); __DQ.instant(true); var offers = 0; for (var s = 1; s <= 60; s++) { __DQ.fight('long_lane', {seed: s}); __DQ.autoplay(40, 'auto'); var r = __DQ.battleResult(); if (r && r.recruit && r.recruit.offer) offers++; } __DQ.instant(false); var out = {offers: offers, wagon: __DQ.state().roster.wagon.length, friends: __DQ.state().roster.friends}; __DQ.rosterRestore(keep); return JSON.stringify(out); })()
